units.source_text: 到了傍晚，老夫人又派人来请，并命打开两室之间的储藏室两边的门，作为通路。

en.t: Toward evening, the elderly lady again sent someone to invite her over, and ordered the doors on both sides of the storeroom between the two rooms to be opened as a passageway.

units.source_text: 老夫人虽然身患病苦，还是毕恭毕敬地接待公主，按照礼仪，下榻相迎。

en.t: Although the elderly lady was suffering from illness, she still received the princess with the utmost respect, getting down from her bed to greet her according to proper etiquette.

units.source_text: 对公主言道：“这屋子里肮脏，邀你过来，也很不好意思。

en.t: She said to the princess, "This room is unclean, so I feel very embarrassed to have asked you to come here.

units.source_text: 才只两三天不见，便像隔了几年，想念得很呢。

en.t: Though we have been apart for only two or three days, it feels as if years have passed, and I have missed you terribly.

units.source_text: 今世虽为母女，后世未必定能相见。

en.t: Although we are mother and daughter in this life, there is no certainty that we will meet again in a future life.

units.source_text: 即使再为母女，但记不得今世之事，也是枉然。

en.t: Even if we were to become mother and daughter again, it would be in vain if we could not remember this present life.

units.source_text: 如此想来，母女之缘实甚短促。

en.t: When I think of it this way, the bond between mother and daughter is truly brief.

units.source_text: 情爱过分亲密，反而教人后悔了。”

en.t: When affection becomes too intimate, it only makes one regret it all the more."
When she had finished speaking, she covered her face and wept.

units.source_text: 落叶公主也百感交集，不胜悲伤，只管注视老母，默默不发一语。

en.t: Princess Ochiba too was overwhelmed by countless feelings and unbearable sorrow; she simply gazed at her aged mother and remained silent, not uttering a word.

units.source_text: 公主生性腼腆，欲语难于启口，只觉不胜羞耻。

en.t: The princess was shy by nature, and though she wanted to speak, she found it hard to begin, feeling only unbearable shame.

units.source_text: 老夫人很可怜她，亦不诘问昨夜之事。

en.t: The elderly lady pitied her deeply and did not question her about what had happened the previous night.

units.source_text: 侍女们立刻点起灯来，又把晚餐送到这里来请用。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting immediately lit the lamps, then brought supper there and urged her to eat.

units.source_text: 老夫人听说公主今日饮食不进，便亲手将肴馔另加调制，但公主一点也不想吃。

en.t: When the elderly lady heard that the princess had eaten nothing that day, she personally prepared the dishes anew, but the princess had no desire to eat at all.

units.source_text: 倒是看见母亲病状好转，她胸怀略觉开朗。

en.t: Still, seeing that her mother's condition had improved, she felt her heart lighten a little.
